Problem.description: An unmet need or obstacle, not inferred user intent from code.

Feature.description: A product capability, not one screen or endpoint.

Spec.description: A scoped requirement or behavioral specification, not an entire source file.

Decision.description: A documented choice and rationale; an inferred choice is not approved.

Note.description: An exploratory note, question or hypothesis; not an authoritative rule.

Evidence.description: A source-backed record supporting a specific claim or relation.

Actor.description: A participating role or external agent, not an individual account.

DomainType.description: A domain concept/type, not automatically a table, DTO or ORM class.

Action.description: A meaningful business action, not every function.

Workflow.description: An arrangement of actions with outcome, order and conditions; membership is not sequence.

BusinessRule.description: A business policy, condition or invariant, not every conditional statement.

Screen.description: A user interaction surface enabling actions, not necessarily a UI file.

Component.description: An implementation unit with responsibility; does not imply a microservice.

Interface.description: An interaction contract such as an API or protocol, not a screen.

AcceptanceCriterion.description: An observable acceptance condition, not a test execution result.

principles: This is an opt-in profile, not the universal contextd or Synapse vocabulary.
Model, verification, review and freshness are independent claim dimensions.
Workflow membership does not imply temporal order, branches, joins or executable semantics.
Source statements, target intent and observed implementation can differ without logical contradiction.
Only the owner of canonical knowledge may apply a reviewed proposal.
